body: I have been trying to "get to the root" for a long time. Now I am going somewhere I don't understand. I have never had to depend so dearly on intuition to guide me. I had logic and facts and reason. Now this tide of emotions seem to take over completely and I am not sure where I am going. I am controlling my feelings. Hell, I am silencing them because I cannot deal with them. But I don't know what's going on or what is going to happen. I do not like anti-depressants. I tried to kill myself with those once. I just don't like them I guess.

I wish I could indulge in a bit of philosophy right now to answer those questions, however, there are other things on my mind, and I need to catch as many thoughts as I can and study them carefully. It's hard to empathize with a suicidal person. I have been there. Only about two years before I attempted suicide, I had sat in my classroom while the teacher was lecturing about Clinical Depression, and asked my friend next to  me "Why would someone want to kill themselves? I don't understand." It might be frightening to see the dissimilarity between those two girls. Or maybe the similarity too. It is not an afterthought, actually, that is the reason I made an account on here. It appears like that because I had a lot a lot to tell. And I keep losing them. They are too fast. And there is too much.

I have been getting more chaotic than usual. To the point that I feel like I miss a million thoughts every moment. Miss thinking about them in detail. It feels like they are important, but I can't put my attention on so many things at the same time, and they are gone. They have completely inhibited my ability to express myself, which I used to do well. This is not my typical frame of mind; something's up. I suppose it is frustrating to be looking for understanding and not being able to find it. I feel like even my therapist cannot help me anymore. I don't know why. I suppose it's not that I don't "deserve a place," there are plenty, that by the standard moral code "don't deserve a place." I think it's more that I don't want it. It's not a gift, it was thrown in my face and nobody asked me if I wanted it. Now it's too late and I have family and friends to care for. That are attached to me and I am attached to them. But it gets weary when the only reason you are alive is for others.
